# Refund Policy

## Standard Refund Window

All purchases are eligible for a full refund within 30 days of purchase.
Items must be returned in original packaging with receipt.

## Late Returns

After 30 days, we offer store credit equal to the purchase price.
Store credit never expires and can be used on any product in our catalog.

## How to Request a Refund

To request a refund, navigate to Orders > Order History > Select Order >
Request Refund. You can also contact our support team at
support@verixstore.com or call 1-800-555-0199 during business hours
(Monday-Friday, 9 AM - 6 PM EST).
